players.product: on-premises superconducting quantum computers (five-qubit IQM Spark; IQM Radiance, approximately 20 to 150 qubits) and IQM Resonance cloud

quarterly_data.quarter: IQM Quantum Computers press release: IQM to deliver its first quantum computer in South America (09-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: IQM signed a purchase agreement with Brazil's Eldorado Research Institute for an IQM Spark quantum computer to be installed at Eldorado's Campinas headquarters in the first quarter of 2027 - IQM's first quantum computer in South America and the first quantum computer purchase by a private research institute in Brazil - including remote access to IQM's 54-qubit cloud-based system in Europe.
quarterly_data.figure: 1 IQM Spark system; installation in the first quarter of 2027
